dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature, forming a smooth falcate spline from the basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour is largely linear with a steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular nicks and small indentations are visible on the lower third of the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse light-colored mottling and pale pigmentation patches are present across the central lateral surface of the fin.
